title: Release check · v0.27.6
notes: Browser items ran against the local server on the HTML and live-site targets. Docs site unreachable offline.

items.title: Annotating HTML works headlessly
items.summary: Opened article.html through the local server, selected paragraph 2, added a comment, applied a quick tag, submitted. The quick-tags popover did not open on the live-site target; the other two targets passed.

findings.text: Quick-tags popover stays closed on the live-site target; the click handler is attached before the toolbar mounts.
Comment highlight lags one frame behind the selection on the markdown target.

checkpoints.label: Page loads
checkpoints.narration: article.html opens through the local server; no console errors.

checkpoints.label: Toolbar renders
checkpoints.narration: All four key buttons present on the HTML target.

checkpoints.label: Comment added
checkpoints.narration: Selecting paragraph 2 and commenting produces the highlight and a stored annotation.

checkpoints.label: Quick tag applied
checkpoints.narration: The tag attaches on the HTML target; on the live-site target the popover never opened.

checkpoints.label: Feedback submitted
checkpoints.narration: Submit succeeds; the payload contains the comment and, on two of three targets, the tag.

items.title: Remote URLs are rewritten to the local server
items.summary: Traced the URL rewrite from the CLI flag to the fetch layer. The rewrite skips URLs with a port, so http://localhost:3000 targets are fetched directly.

findings.text: rewriteRemote() matches on hostname only and returns early when the URL carries a port.

items.title: Bun is still pinned to 1.3.x
items.summary: The packageManager field is unchanged, but bun.lock moved from 1.3.9 to 1.3.11 in this change set. The list says no naive upgrades; this one came in with a dependency bump.

findings.text: bun.lock records 1.3.11; the last tag records 1.3.9. Decide whether the bump is intended.

items.title: A change touches the config schema
items.summary: Always-flag rule. The change set adds an optional field to config.schema.json; existing configs still validate.

findings.text: New optional field annotate.quickTags; default preserves current behavior.

items.title: Every toolbar button is present
items.summary: All four key buttons are present on markdown, HTML, and live-site targets. Recorded on the HTML target; the other two checked by DOM assertion.

findings.text: Button set unchanged from v0.27.5: comment, thumbs up, quick tags, submit.

checkpoints.label: Page loads
checkpoints.narration: article.html opens through the local server.

items.title: The diff loads on a 2MB file
items.summary: Loaded the 2.1MB fixture diff; first paint at 1.4s, scroll stayed responsive, no console errors.

items.title: Prompt cache prefix is preserved
items.summary: The system prompt assembly order is unchanged; the cache-control marker still sits after the static prefix.

findings.text: assemblePrompt() emits the static prefix first, then the marker, then per-turn content.

items.title: The install script still targets both paths
items.summary: install.sh writes to both the Pi and the OpenCode locations; both branches are exercised by the install test.

items.title: Docs match the shipped flags
items.summary: The docs site was unreachable offline, so the shipped flags could not be compared against the published pages.

items.title: Dependency versions match the allowlist
items.summary: Dependencies unchanged since v0.27.5, apart from the Bun bump flagged above.
